hook: Six women independently accused 51-year-old Russell Brand of being a calculated sexual predator.

sections.voiceover: Six women independently accused 51-year-old Russell Brand of being a calculated sexual predator.
At Southwark Crown Court, prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones KC opened the case against the comedian. How did these six women, who never met, connect their individual stories of abuse?
But the prosecution claims these six women never met before coming forward to report abuse.
Karmy-Jones KC revealed a pattern of behavior spanning ten years. The trial in London examines seven sexual offense charges brought against the 51-year-old defendant.
Jurors at Southwark Crown Court are now weighing the testimony of these six women.
